label: D1 after an a1 -> S2 rare transition
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never at GO or D2). On dev it fires on about 95% of D1 steps right after a trial where the agent chose a1 and got the rare transition to S2. Mirrored rare trials (a2 -> S1) add essentially no activations. Activation is higher when that rare trial was unrewarded: the unrewarded subset alone gets precision 0.97 and holds 54% of the mass. Dev precision 0.95, recall 0.65, mass recall 0.70. Most misses are at D1 of the window first trial (rel -3, about 16% of mass), where the previous trial is outside the window and cannot be checked. The rest are weak activations, mostly at D1 after a2 trials ending in S2, especially unrewarded ones. Adding (prev_state == 2) & (prev_reward == 0) raises recall to 0.78 but drops precision to 0.62. Fires slightly more often later in the episode. The rate is higher when the upcoming choice is a1 (positive policy logit), consistent with the model-based switch toward a1 after a rare-unrewarded a1 trial. Uses only observed history.
